clauses.quote: Version 4.2, last changed 12 August 2026
clauses.reading: Identifies this version of the terms.

clauses.quote: Brothbike is not a real company or service
clauses.reading: A note that this whole document is invented for the demo.

clauses.quote: have it delivered by independent couriers
clauses.reading: Brothbike sits in the middle, between you, the restaurants and the couriers.

clauses.quote: each restaurant is responsible for its own food, including allergen information
clauses.reading: Problems with the food itself are the restaurant's responsibility, not Brothbike's.

clauses.quote: Couriers are independent contractors, not Brothbike employees
clauses.reading: By not employing couriers, Brothbike keeps its distance from how deliveries are done.

clauses.quote: which it may accept or reject
clauses.reading: Your order is only a request until the restaurant accepts it.

clauses.quote: may differ from prices charged in the restaurant itself
clauses.reading: Food can cost more in the app than at the counter, and the terms don't say by how much.

clauses.quote: shown before you pay
clauses.reading: Delivery, service and busy-time fees are added, but you see them before paying.

clauses.quote: the total shown at checkout is the total you pay for that order
clauses.reading: Fees can change at any time, but not after you have seen your total.

clauses.quote: We charge your payment method when the restaurant accepts your order
clauses.reading: You are charged once the restaurant says yes.

clauses.quote: a temporary authorisation hold of up to 20 percent above the order total
clauses.reading: Your card can be held for up to a fifth more than the order costs.

clauses.quote: Delivery times shown in the app are estimates only
clauses.reading: Delivery times are guesses, not promises.

clauses.quote: We are not liable for late deliveries
clauses.reading: Late food caused by traffic, weather or the restaurant is not their problem.

clauses.quote: You can cancel an order free of charge until the restaurant accepts it
clauses.reading: Cancelling costs nothing until the restaurant accepts.

clauses.quote: cancellations may be charged in full
clauses.reading: Once accepted, cancelling can cost you the whole order.

clauses.quote: we will refund the affected items
clauses.reading: Missing or wrong items are refunded if you report them within 48 hours.

clauses.quote: may be given as Brothbike credit rather than money
clauses.reading: Other refunds are optional, and may come as app credit instead of money.

clauses.quote: Brothbike credit expires 6 months after it is issued
clauses.reading: Credit disappears after six months and can never be cashed out.

clauses.quote: You may add a tip for your courier before or after delivery
clauses.reading: Tipping is optional and can wait until the food arrives.

clauses.quote: Couriers receive 100 percent of tips
clauses.reading: Your whole tip goes to the courier.

clauses.quote: contact the restaurant directly before ordering
clauses.reading: Allergy questions go to the restaurant, not to Brothbike.

clauses.quote: We cannot guarantee that any food is free from allergens
clauses.reading: Brothbike makes no allergen promises at all.

clauses.quote: You can rate restaurants and couriers
clauses.reading: You can leave ratings.

clauses.quote: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide licence to use, edit and publish it, including in advertising, with your first name
clauses.reading: Your review can be edited and used in adverts under your first name, forever.

clauses.quote: We may remove reviews that are abusive, false or unrelated to the order
clauses.reading: They decide which reviews count as false or off-topic and can take them down.

clauses.quote: if we suspect fraud, abuse of refunds or promotions
clauses.reading: Suspicion alone, including of 'abusing' refunds, can get your account suspended.

clauses.quote: close accounts that have not been used for 24 months
clauses.reading: Accounts left unused for two years can be closed.

clauses.quote: while an order is active, your device location
clauses.reading: Your device location is collected only while an order is on its way.

clauses.quote: We share your name, address and phone number with the restaurant and the courier for your order
clauses.reading: The people making and delivering your order get your contact details.

clauses.quote: you can opt out of marketing messages at any time in Settings
clauses.reading: Marketing based on your orders is on by default, but you can switch it off.

clauses.quote: We may share your personal data with advertising partners
clauses.reading: Your personal data can go to advertising partners to measure their adverts.

clauses.quote: may be withdrawn at any time
clauses.reading: Promo codes can be pulled whenever they like.

clauses.quote: Nothing in these Terms affects your statutory rights as a consumer
clauses.reading: Your legal rights as a consumer still apply.

clauses.quote: limited to the amount you paid for that order
clauses.reading: At most, you get back what you paid for the order.

clauses.quote: not reasonably foreseeable when you placed the order
clauses.reading: Unexpected knock-on losses are excluded, as is usual.

clauses.quote: We may change these Terms at any time
clauses.reading: They can change the terms whenever they like.

clauses.quote: The version in force when you place an order applies to that order
clauses.reading: A change cannot reach back to an order you have already placed.

clauses.quote: give us 30 days to try to resolve it
clauses.reading: You must give support 30 days before starting any legal claim.

clauses.quote: governed by the laws of the Republic of Examplia
clauses.reading: The law of Examplia applies.

clauses.quote: Support is available in the app or at care@brothbike.example
clauses.reading: Where to get support.
